notes.title: Update 1.37
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36014417/1cca75c15281c6985a89c31cf162b07533cd2a46.png[/img]
Happy New Year!

We prepared a new update that contains bug fixes and content optimization. Most importantly, the bug with unlocking achievements has been fixed.

[h1]The game has been updated to version 1.37[/h1]
Here's a list of the main changes:
[list]
[*] New version of Ren’Py
[*] DLC Foreign Languages Club support
[*] Unlocking achievements bug has been fixed
[*] Some of content has been optimized
[/list]
[h1]Foreign Languages Club DLC is available on Steam![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2285680/BlackberryNOVA__Foreign_Languages_Club/?snr=1_5_9__405
This is the second story DLC that adds Sapphire's route to the game.

[quote]To get closer to Sapphire, Kotori decides to join a Foreign Languages Club with her.
But previously she was not at all interested in foreign languages and now she has to redouble her efforts to study it.[/quote]
[i]The content of the DLC does not require you to go through the main story of the game, it can be played separately
Before installing the DLC it is necessary to update the game to version 1.37[/i]

[h1]Bundle: The Game + 2 DLC[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36014417/7a5765b99b74d576ca87f4327c0998bffe27683d.png[/img]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28663/BlackberryNOVA_gold_edition/?snr=1_5_9__403]BlackberryNOVA gold edition[/url] bundle is also available! It's contain the game + 2 DLC with a discount.

notes.title: BlackberryNOVA 1st Anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36014417/58d25084bce6e5092c5961f9e6c3c692e60146d6.png[/img]
The game is celebrating its first anniversary! In honor of this, we have prepared several updates.

We want to thank our readers, your support and feedback energizes us with motivation and ideas to improve our games.
We'll keep trying to make a bunch of interesting content for you. Thank you for staying with us!

[h2]The game has been updated to version 1.36[/h2]
Here's a list of the main changes:
[list]
[*] New version of Ren’Py
[*] DLC support
[*] Fixed bug with the root selection menu
[*] Some of the graphical content has been optimized
[/list]
[h2]The Sports Club DLC is available on Steam![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1920000/BlackberryNOVA__Sports_Club/

This is the first story DLC that adds a route with Izumi to the game.

[quote=Description]To get closer to Izumi, Kotori decides to join a sports club with her.
But the trouble is, she can't play tennis at all! And there's a big 2x2 tournament coming up...[/quote]
[i]The content of the DLC does not require you to go through the main story of the game, it can be played separately
Before installing the DLC it is necessary to update the game to version 1.36[/i]

[h2]Bundle: The Game + DLC[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36014417/a897e61ad225101eb4a59be6626d5fcfe525073d.png[/img]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28663/BlackberryNOVA_anniversary_edition/] BlackberryNOVA anniversary edition bundle[/url] is also available, which allows you to buy the game and DLC with a discount.
